minutes.headline: Planning Board approved two ANR plans and the Bright Farms stormwater and site plan, but held off waiving site plan review for 88 Mass Ave.
minutes.summary: The remote Planning Board meeting approved ANR plans for 318/384 Howard Street and 250 Howard Street, then spent a long stretch on a site plan waiver request for 88 Massachusetts Avenue. The board asked for an engineered plan and no waiver was granted. It closed the 361 Mass Ave (Bright Farms) hearing and approved the stormwater permit and site plan with added conditions, then took up minutes, committee reports and director's items.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment; none offered. Land use director noted town offices are now by appointment only.
Closing public comment: no public present.

votes.motion: Approve the ANR plan for 318 and 384 Howard Street
Approve the ANR plan for 250 Howard Street
Close the public hearing for 361 Mass Ave (stormwater permit and site plan approval)
Approve the stormwater permit and site plan for 361 Mass Ave LLC / Mass Greenhouse LLC with the 11 conditions plus four added this evening

budget_items.topic: State shared winter streets and spaces grants
budget_items.what_was_said: A new round of shared winter streets and spaces funding is open for small public-space projects.
Mass Trails grants are open for 2021 applications and the town could apply again after an earlier trail grant.
A member relayed that forest land under care of a body other than conservation could be eligible for a reimbursement.

decisions.decision: Board asked the 88 Mass Ave applicant to return with an engineered plan showing paved and unpaved areas, parking layout, uses and areas, property lines, leased land and snow storage; no waiver granted.
88 Mass Ave request not formally continued; applicant will contact the land use director to be put back on the agenda.
Third-party stormwater monitor to be added to the Bright Farms decision.
Construction hours set at 7 to 5 weekdays and 8 to 4 Saturdays, with a condition that Pope Road not be used for construction access.
Bright Farms decision to be signed by DocuSign.
Parking calculations to be discussed at an upcoming meeting; the December 28 workshop on subdivision rules and regulations continues.
Question of plan-sized copies for members to go on the next agenda.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the stormwater permit and site plan for 361 Mass Ave (Bright Farms) with the 11 conditions plus four added at the meeting.
The board granted no site plan review waiver for 88 Mass Ave and asked the applicant to return with an engineered plan.
The 88 Mass Ave request was not formally continued; the applicant will contact the land use director to be placed back on the agenda.
The board approved ANR plans for 318 and 384 Howard Street, and for 250 Howard Street.
Conditions on the Bright Farms decision include a third-party stormwater monitor, set construction hours, and no construction access via Pope Road.

why_it_matters: The Bright Farms approval sets stormwater monitoring and construction-hour limits that affect drainage and traffic for neighbors along Mass Ave and Pope Road.
The 88 Mass Ave request stays unresolved until an engineered plan is submitted, so any change to how that site is used or paved has not yet been cleared.
watch_next: Return of the 88 Mass Ave applicant with an engineered plan, once placed on a future agenda.
The December 28 workshop on subdivision rules and regulations, and a coming discussion of parking calculations.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the main outcomes: the 250 Howard ANR, the 361 Mass Ave approval with 11 plus 4 conditions, the construction hours, and the return of the 88 Mass Ave applicant. They differ on the 318/384 Howard ANR tally (an abstention in the official minutes), on Torgersen's attendance, and on the Mass Trails figure.
